title: ทะเบียนสินค้า: เพิ่มกรอกครบทุกส่วน ตรวจกฎบังคับ คัดลอก แก้ไข ค้นหา ลบ และกันลบสินค้าที่ใช้แล้ว
description: ItemScreen บนจอ menu_ic_item_detail (ic_inventory + ic_unit_use + ic_opposite_unit + ic_inventory_barcode + ic_wh_shelf + ic_standard_cost): เพิ่มสินค้าหลายหน่วยนับ A กรอกครบหัวฟอร์ม 11 ช่องค้นหา ธง 11 ตัว หน่วยนับ 4 แถว หน่วยนับเทียบ 2 แถว บาร์โค้ด 4 แถว (EAN-13 และเลข 4 หลักที่ระบบสร้าง) ราคา 8 ช่อง คลัง/ที่เก็บ 2 แถว ต้นทุนมาตรฐาน 2 แถว ส่วนอื่นๆ ตรวจกฎบังคับและคำเตือนทุกข้อ พิสูจน์คอลัมน์ในฐานข้อมูลทุกตาราง คัดลอกเป็น B (รหัสซ้ำ/บาร์โค้ดซ้ำข้ามสินค้า) แก้ไข A ทุกส่วน ยกเลิกการแก้ไข คำเตือนเปลี่ยนรายการ/ปิดแท็บ เพิ่มสินค้าหน่วยนับเดี่ยว C (ขนาด/น้ำหนักจากหัวฟอร์ม) ค้นหา เรียง กรอง ค้นด้วยบาร์โค้ด สลับมุมมองตามบาร์โค้ด กัน/ลบสินค้าที่ใช้แล้ว ลบ A B C พร้อมตารางลูกทุกตาราง และกล่อง Lock ท้ายสุด ใช้ค่าจริงจาก smldemo ไม่แต่งข้อมูล

steps.title: เลือกหน่วยนับจริง 5 ตัว (รหัสตัวพิมพ์ใหญ่ ไม่ใช่ UAT) ไว้ใส่ตารางหน่วยนับ
steps.sql: with x as (select code, name_1, row_number() over (order by code) as rn from (select code, name_1 from ic_unit where code !~ '["\\~'']' and name_1 !~ '["\\~'']' and name_1 = btrim(name_1) and name_1 !~ '  ' and coalesce(name_1,'') <> '' and code = btrim(code) and code !~ ' ' and code = upper(code) and code !~ '^UAT' and length(code) <= 12) y) select max(code) filter (where rn = 1) as u1, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 1) as un1, max(code) filter (where rn = 2) as u2, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 2) as un2, max(code) filter (where rn = 3) as u3, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 3) as un3, max(code) filter (where rn = 4) as u4, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 4) as un4, max(code) filter (where rn = 5) as u5, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 5) as un5 from x

steps.title: เลือกประเภทรายได้จริง 2 ตัว
steps.sql: with x as (select code, name_1, row_number() over (order by code) as rn from (select code, name_1 from erp_income_list where code !~ '["\\~'']' and name_1 !~ '["\\~'']' and name_1 = btrim(name_1) and name_1 !~ '  ' and coalesce(name_1,'') <> '' and code = btrim(code) and code !~ ' ') y) select max(code) filter (where rn = 1) as i1, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 1) as in1, max(code) filter (where rn = 2) as i2, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 2) as in2 from x

steps.title: เลือกรูปแบบสินค้าจริง 2 ตัว
steps.sql: with x as (select code, name_1, row_number() over (order by code) as rn from (select code, name_1 from ic_pattern where code !~ '["\\~'']' and name_1 !~ '["\\~'']' and name_1 = btrim(name_1) and name_1 !~ '  ' and coalesce(name_1,'') <> '' and code = btrim(code) and code !~ ' ') y) select max(code) filter (where rn = 1) as p1, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 1) as pn1, max(code) filter (where rn = 2) as p2, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 2) as pn2 from x

steps.title: เลือกเครื่องหมายจริง 2 ตัว
steps.sql: with x as (select code, name_1, row_number() over (order by code) as rn from (select code, name_1 from ic_design where code !~ '["\\~'']' and name_1 !~ '["\\~'']' and name_1 = btrim(name_1) and name_1 !~ '  ' and coalesce(name_1,'') <> '' and code = btrim(code) and code !~ ' ') y) select max(code) filter (where rn = 1) as d1, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 1) as dn1, max(code) filter (where rn = 2) as d2, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 2) as dn2 from x

steps.title: เลือกผู้จำหน่ายจริง 4 ตัว (ใช้เป็นผู้จัดจำหน่ายหลักและผู้ผลิต)
steps.sql: with x as (select code, name_1, row_number() over (order by code) as rn from (select code, name_1 from ap_supplier where code !~ '["\\~'']' and name_1 !~ '["\\~'']' and name_1 = btrim(name_1) and name_1 !~ '  ' and coalesce(name_1,'') <> '' and code = btrim(code) and code !~ ' ' and code !~ '^UAT') y) select max(code) filter (where rn = 1) as s1, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 1) as sn1, max(code) filter (where rn = 2) as s2, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 2) as sn2, max(code) filter (where rn = 3) as s3, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 3) as sn3, max(code) filter (where rn = 4) as s4, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 4) as sn4 from x

steps.title: เลือกผังบัญชีจริง 8 ตัว (ไม่ใช่ UAT)
steps.sql: with x as (select code, name_1, row_number() over (order by code) as rn from (select code, name_1 from gl_chart_of_account where code !~ '["\\~'']' and name_1 !~ '["\\~'']' and name_1 = btrim(name_1) and name_1 !~ '  ' and coalesce(name_1,'') <> '' and code = btrim(code) and code !~ ' ' and code !~ '^UAT' and coalesce(account_level,0) >= 1 and coalesce(status,0) = 0) y) select max(code) filter (where rn = 1) as g1, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 1) as gn1, max(code) filter (where rn = 2) as g2, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 2) as gn2, max(code) filter (where rn = 3) as g3, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 3) as gn3, max(code) filter (where rn = 4) as g4, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 4) as gn4, max(code) filter (where rn = 5) as g5, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 5) as gn5, max(code) filter (where rn = 6) as g6, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 6) as gn6, max(code) filter (where rn = 7) as g7, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 7) as gn7, max(code) filter (where rn = 8) as g8, max(name_1) filter (where rn = 8) as gn8 from x

steps.title: เลือกคู่ คลัง+ที่เก็บ จริง 2 คู่ จากคนละคลัง (ที่เก็บต้องสัมพันธ์กับคลัง)
steps.sql: with x as (select distinct on (w.code) w.code as wh, w.name_1 as wn, s.code as sh, s.name_1 as shn from ic_warehouse w join ic_shelf s on s.whcode = w.code where w.code !~ '["\\~'']' and w.name_1 !~ '["\\~'']' and w.name_1 = btrim(w.name_1) and w.name_1 !~ '  ' and coalesce(w.name_1,'') <> '' and w.code = btrim(w.code) and w.code !~ ' ' and s.code !~ '["\\~'']' and s.name_1 !~ '["\\~'']' and s.name_1 = btrim(s.name_1) and s.name_1 !~ '  ' and coalesce(s.name_1,'') <> '' and s.code = btrim(s.code) and s.code !~ ' ' order by w.code, s.code), y as (select *, row_number() over (order by wh) as rn from x) select max(wh) filter (where rn = 1) as wh1, max(wn) filter (where rn = 1) as wn1, max(sh) filter (where rn = 1) as sh1, max(shn) filter (where rn = 1) as shn1, max(wh) filter (where rn = 2) as wh2, max(wn) filter (where rn = 2) as wn2, max(sh) filter (where rn = 2) as sh2, max(shn) filter (where rn = 2) as shn2 from y

steps.title: จำนวนแถวที่หน้าจอจะดึงมาให้อัตโนมัติเมื่อกดเพิ่มสินค้าใหม่ (ทุกที่เก็บใน ic_shelf) และสวิตช์คลัง/ที่เก็บทั้งหมดของ erp_option
steps.sql: select (select count(*) from ic_shelf)::text as shelf_total, coalesce((select enable_all_ic_wh_shelf from erp_option limit 1), 0)::text as ew

steps.title: เลือกสินค้าจริงที่ไม่ใช่ UAT ไว้ทดสอบค้นหาและเปิดดู (ชื่อไม่มีอักขระพิเศษ)
steps.sql: select code as real_code, name_1 as real_name from ic_inventory where code !~ '^UAT' and code !~ '["\\~'']' and name_1 !~ '["\\~'']' and name_1 = btrim(name_1) and name_1 !~ '  ' and coalesce(name_1,'') <> '' and code = btrim(code) and code !~ ' ' order by code desc limit 1

steps.title: รหัสสินค้าแรกสุดของรายการ (จอโหลดรายการแรกให้อัตโนมัติ)

steps.title: ก่อนเริ่ม ยังไม่มีสินค้า UAT ของรอบนี้
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as cnt from ic_inventory where code ~ ('^UAT' || :'run_short' || 'I[ABC]$')

steps.sql: select i.code as code, i.name_1 as name_1, coalesce(i.name_2::text,'') as name_2, coalesce(i.name_eng_1::text,'') as name_eng_1, coalesce(i.name_eng_2::text,'') as name_eng_2, coalesce(i.unit_cost::text,'') as unit_cost, coalesce(i.unit_standard::text,'') as unit_standard, coalesce(i.income_type::text,'') as income_type, coalesce(i.item_pattern::text,'') as item_pattern, coalesce(i.supplier_code::text,'') as supplier_code, coalesce(i.sign_code::text,'') as sign_code, coalesce(i.manufacturer_code::text,'') as manufacturer_code, coalesce(i.account_code_1::text,'') as account_code_1, coalesce(i.account_code_2::text,'') as account_code_2, coalesce(i.account_code_3::text,'') as account_code_3, coalesce(i.account_code_4::text,'') as account_code_4, coalesce(i.tax_type,0)::text as tax, coalesce(i.item_type,0)::text as itype, coalesce(i.unit_type,0)::text as utype, coalesce(i.cost_type,0)::text as ctype, coalesce(i.ic_serial_no,0)::text as serial, coalesce(i.update_detail,0)::text as upd_detail, coalesce(i.update_price,0)::text as upd_price, coalesce(i.drink_type,0)::text as drink, coalesce(i.use_expire,0)::text as expire, coalesce(i.barcode_checker_print,0)::text as bcprint, coalesce(i.print_order_per_unit,0)::text as pounit, coalesce(i.is_eordershow,0)::text as eorder, coalesce(i.is_speech,0)::text as speech, coalesce(i.pos_no_sum,0)::text as posno, coalesce(i.production_period,0)::text as prod, coalesce(d.have_point,0)::text as point from ic_inventory i left join ic_inventory_detail d on upper(d.ic_code) = upper(i.code) where i.code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IA'

expect.value: สินค้าทดสอบ ALPHA{{run.short}}
ชื่อสินค้าที่สอง {{run.short}}

steps.title: DB A หลังบันทึก: ตารางหน่วยนับ
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg(code || ':' || stand_value::float8::text || '/' || divide_value::float8::text || ':' || coalesce(width_length_height,'') || ':' || case when weight ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' then weight::float8::text else coalesce(weight,'') end || ':' || coalesce(unit_size::float8::text,'') || ':' || coalesce(status,0)::text, ' | ' order by line_number), '') as s from ic_unit_use where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IA'

steps.title: DB A หลังบันทึก: ตารางหน่วยนับเทียบ
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg(unit_code || ':' || stand_value::float8::text || '/' || divide_value::float8::text || ':' || round(ratio,4)::float8::text || ':' || coalesce(status,0)::text, ' | ' order by line_number), '') as s from ic_opposite_unit where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IA'

steps.title: DB A หลังบันทึก: ตารางบาร์โค้ดและราคา
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg((case when barcode ~ '^2[0-9]{12}$' then 'EAN' when barcode ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' then 'D4' else barcode end) || ':' || unit_code || ':' || price::float8::text || ',' || price_member::float8::text || ',' || price_2::float8::text || ',' || price_member_2::float8::text || ',' || price_3::float8::text || ',' || price_member_3::float8::text || ',' || price_4::float8::text || ',' || price_member_4::float8::text || ':' || coalesce(hidden_text,0)::text || coalesce(no_point,0)::text || coalesce(is_clearance,0)::text || ':' || coalesce(from_date::text,'') || '~' || coalesce(to_date::text,''), ' | ' order by line_number), '') as s from ic_inventory_barcode where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IA'

steps.title: DB A หลังบันทึก: ตารางคลัง/ที่เก็บ
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg(wh_code || '/' || shelf_code || ':' || coalesce(shelf_list,'') || ':' || coalesce(min_point,0)::text || ':' || coalesce(max_point,0)::float8::text || ':' || coalesce(status,0)::text, ' | ' order by wh_code, shelf_code), '') as s from ic_wh_shelf where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IA'

steps.title: DB A หลังบันทึก: ต้นทุนมาตรฐาน
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg(date_start::text || ':' || unit_code || ':' || cost1::float8::text, ' | ' order by date_start), '') as s from ic_standard_cost where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IA'

steps.title: DB A หลังบันทึก: ค่าที่ระบบคำนวณเองหลังบันทึก
steps.sql: select coalesce(i.unit_standard_name,'') as ustd_name, coalesce(i.unit_standard_stand_value,0)::float8::text as ustd_st, coalesce(i.unit_standard_divide_value,0)::float8::text as ustd_dv, (select count(*) from ic_inventory_barcode b where b.ic_code = i.code and coalesce(b.description,'') <> i.name_1)::text as bad_desc, case when coalesce(i.create_code,'') <> '' and i.create_datetime is not null then 'ok' else 'bad' end as created_by from ic_inventory i where i.code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IA'

steps.title: DB: master_logs บันทึกการเพิ่ม A 1 ครั้ง
steps.sql: select count(*) filter (where function_code = 1)::text as n_new, count(*) filter (where function_code = 2)::text as n_edit, count(*) filter (where function_code = 3)::text as n_del from master_logs where menu_name = 'menu_ic_item_detail' and code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IA'

steps.title: DB: A ลำดับที่ของหน่วยนับตามลำดับแถว

steps.title: DB B (สำเนา): หัวสินค้าและธงทุกตัว
steps.sql: select i.code as code, i.name_1 as name_1, coalesce(i.name_2::text,'') as name_2, coalesce(i.name_eng_1::text,'') as name_eng_1, coalesce(i.name_eng_2::text,'') as name_eng_2, coalesce(i.unit_cost::text,'') as unit_cost, coalesce(i.unit_standard::text,'') as unit_standard, coalesce(i.income_type::text,'') as income_type, coalesce(i.item_pattern::text,'') as item_pattern, coalesce(i.supplier_code::text,'') as supplier_code, coalesce(i.sign_code::text,'') as sign_code, coalesce(i.manufacturer_code::text,'') as manufacturer_code, coalesce(i.account_code_1::text,'') as account_code_1, coalesce(i.account_code_2::text,'') as account_code_2, coalesce(i.account_code_3::text,'') as account_code_3, coalesce(i.account_code_4::text,'') as account_code_4, coalesce(i.tax_type,0)::text as tax, coalesce(i.item_type,0)::text as itype, coalesce(i.unit_type,0)::text as utype, coalesce(i.cost_type,0)::text as ctype, coalesce(i.ic_serial_no,0)::text as serial, coalesce(i.update_detail,0)::text as upd_detail, coalesce(i.update_price,0)::text as upd_price, coalesce(i.drink_type,0)::text as drink, coalesce(i.use_expire,0)::text as expire, coalesce(i.barcode_checker_print,0)::text as bcprint, coalesce(i.print_order_per_unit,0)::text as pounit, coalesce(i.is_eordershow,0)::text as eorder, coalesce(i.is_speech,0)::text as speech, coalesce(i.pos_no_sum,0)::text as posno, coalesce(i.production_period,0)::text as prod, coalesce(d.have_point,0)::text as point from ic_inventory i left join ic_inventory_detail d on upper(d.ic_code) = upper(i.code) where i.code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IB'

steps.title: DB B (สำเนา): ตารางหน่วยนับ
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg(code || ':' || stand_value::float8::text || '/' || divide_value::float8::text || ':' || coalesce(width_length_height,'') || ':' || case when weight ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' then weight::float8::text else coalesce(weight,'') end || ':' || coalesce(unit_size::float8::text,'') || ':' || coalesce(status,0)::text, ' | ' order by line_number), '') as s from ic_unit_use where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IB'

steps.title: DB B (สำเนา): ตารางหน่วยนับเทียบ
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg(unit_code || ':' || stand_value::float8::text || '/' || divide_value::float8::text || ':' || round(ratio,4)::float8::text || ':' || coalesce(status,0)::text, ' | ' order by line_number), '') as s from ic_opposite_unit where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IB'

steps.title: DB B (สำเนา): ตารางบาร์โค้ดและราคา
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg((case when barcode ~ '^2[0-9]{12}$' then 'EAN' when barcode ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' then 'D4' else barcode end) || ':' || unit_code || ':' || price::float8::text || ',' || price_member::float8::text || ',' || price_2::float8::text || ',' || price_member_2::float8::text || ',' || price_3::float8::text || ',' || price_member_3::float8::text || ',' || price_4::float8::text || ',' || price_member_4::float8::text || ':' || coalesce(hidden_text,0)::text || coalesce(no_point,0)::text || coalesce(is_clearance,0)::text || ':' || coalesce(from_date::text,'') || '~' || coalesce(to_date::text,''), ' | ' order by line_number), '') as s from ic_inventory_barcode where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IB'

steps.title: DB B (สำเนา): ตารางคลัง/ที่เก็บ
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg(wh_code || '/' || shelf_code || ':' || coalesce(shelf_list,'') || ':' || coalesce(min_point,0)::text || ':' || coalesce(max_point,0)::float8::text || ':' || coalesce(status,0)::text, ' | ' order by wh_code, shelf_code), '') as s from ic_wh_shelf where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IB'

steps.title: DB B (สำเนา): ต้นทุนมาตรฐาน
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg(date_start::text || ':' || unit_code || ':' || cost1::float8::text, ' | ' order by date_start), '') as s from ic_standard_cost where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IB'

steps.title: DB B (สำเนา): ค่าที่ระบบคำนวณเองหลังบันทึก
steps.sql: select coalesce(i.unit_standard_name,'') as ustd_name, coalesce(i.unit_standard_stand_value,0)::float8::text as ustd_st, coalesce(i.unit_standard_divide_value,0)::float8::text as ustd_dv, (select count(*) from ic_inventory_barcode b where b.ic_code = i.code and coalesce(b.description,'') <> i.name_1)::text as bad_desc, case when coalesce(i.create_code,'') <> '' and i.create_datetime is not null then 'ok' else 'bad' end as created_by from ic_inventory i where i.code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IB'

steps.title: DB: master_logs บันทึกการเพิ่ม B 1 ครั้ง
steps.sql: select count(*) filter (where function_code = 1)::text as n_new, count(*) filter (where function_code = 2)::text as n_edit, count(*) filter (where function_code = 3)::text as n_del from master_logs where menu_name = 'menu_ic_item_detail' and code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IB'

steps.title: DB: A ยังไม่เปลี่ยนหลังสำเนา
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg((case when barcode ~ '^2[0-9]{12}$' then 'EAN' when barcode ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' then 'D4' else barcode end) || ':' || unit_code || ':' || price::float8::text || ',' || price_member::float8::text || ',' || price_2::float8::text || ',' || price_member_2::float8::text || ',' || price_3::float8::text || ',' || price_member_3::float8::text || ',' || price_4::float8::text || ',' || price_member_4::float8::text || ':' || coalesce(hidden_text,0)::text || coalesce(no_point,0)::text || coalesce(is_clearance,0)::text || ':' || coalesce(from_date::text,'') || '~' || coalesce(to_date::text,''), ' | ' order by line_number), '') as s from ic_inventory_barcode where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IA'

steps.title: DB: ละทิ้งการแก้ไขแล้ว ชื่อ A ไม่เปลี่ยน
steps.sql: select i.code as code, i.name_1 as name_1, coalesce(i.name_2::text,'') as name_2, coalesce(i.name_eng_1::text,'') as name_eng_1, coalesce(i.name_eng_2::text,'') as name_eng_2, coalesce(i.unit_cost::text,'') as unit_cost, coalesce(i.unit_standard::text,'') as unit_standard, coalesce(i.income_type::text,'') as income_type, coalesce(i.item_pattern::text,'') as item_pattern, coalesce(i.supplier_code::text,'') as supplier_code, coalesce(i.sign_code::text,'') as sign_code, coalesce(i.manufacturer_code::text,'') as manufacturer_code, coalesce(i.account_code_1::text,'') as account_code_1, coalesce(i.account_code_2::text,'') as account_code_2, coalesce(i.account_code_3::text,'') as account_code_3, coalesce(i.account_code_4::text,'') as account_code_4, coalesce(i.tax_type,0)::text as tax, coalesce(i.item_type,0)::text as itype, coalesce(i.unit_type,0)::text as utype, coalesce(i.cost_type,0)::text as ctype, coalesce(i.ic_serial_no,0)::text as serial, coalesce(i.update_detail,0)::text as upd_detail, coalesce(i.update_price,0)::text as upd_price, coalesce(i.drink_type,0)::text as drink, coalesce(i.use_expire,0)::text as expire, coalesce(i.barcode_checker_print,0)::text as bcprint, coalesce(i.print_order_per_unit,0)::text as pounit, coalesce(i.is_eordershow,0)::text as eorder, coalesce(i.is_speech,0)::text as speech, coalesce(i.pos_no_sum,0)::text as posno, coalesce(i.production_period,0)::text as prod, coalesce(d.have_point,0)::text as point from ic_inventory i left join ic_inventory_detail d on upper(d.ic_code) = upper(i.code) where i.code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IA'

steps.title: DB A หลังแก้ไข: หัวสินค้าและธงทุกตัว
steps.sql: select i.code as code, i.name_1 as name_1, coalesce(i.name_2::text,'') as name_2, coalesce(i.name_eng_1::text,'') as name_eng_1, coalesce(i.name_eng_2::text,'') as name_eng_2, coalesce(i.unit_cost::text,'') as unit_cost, coalesce(i.unit_standard::text,'') as unit_standard, coalesce(i.income_type::text,'') as income_type, coalesce(i.item_pattern::text,'') as item_pattern, coalesce(i.supplier_code::text,'') as supplier_code, coalesce(i.sign_code::text,'') as sign_code, coalesce(i.manufacturer_code::text,'') as manufacturer_code, coalesce(i.account_code_1::text,'') as account_code_1, coalesce(i.account_code_2::text,'') as account_code_2, coalesce(i.account_code_3::text,'') as account_code_3, coalesce(i.account_code_4::text,'') as account_code_4, coalesce(i.tax_type,0)::text as tax, coalesce(i.item_type,0)::text as itype, coalesce(i.unit_type,0)::text as utype, coalesce(i.cost_type,0)::text as ctype, coalesce(i.ic_serial_no,0)::text as serial, coalesce(i.update_detail,0)::text as upd_detail, coalesce(i.update_price,0)::text as upd_price, coalesce(i.drink_type,0)::text as drink, coalesce(i.use_expire,0)::text as expire, coalesce(i.barcode_checker_print,0)::text as bcprint, coalesce(i.print_order_per_unit,0)::text as pounit, coalesce(i.is_eordershow,0)::text as eorder, coalesce(i.is_speech,0)::text as speech, coalesce(i.pos_no_sum,0)::text as posno, coalesce(i.production_period,0)::text as prod, coalesce(d.have_point,0)::text as point from ic_inventory i left join ic_inventory_detail d on upper(d.ic_code) = upper(i.code) where i.code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IA'

steps.title: DB A หลังแก้ไข: ตารางหน่วยนับ
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg(code || ':' || stand_value::float8::text || '/' || divide_value::float8::text || ':' || coalesce(width_length_height,'') || ':' || case when weight ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' then weight::float8::text else coalesce(weight,'') end || ':' || coalesce(unit_size::float8::text,'') || ':' || coalesce(status,0)::text, ' | ' order by line_number), '') as s from ic_unit_use where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IA'

steps.title: DB A หลังแก้ไข: ตารางหน่วยนับเทียบ
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg(unit_code || ':' || stand_value::float8::text || '/' || divide_value::float8::text || ':' || round(ratio,4)::float8::text || ':' || coalesce(status,0)::text, ' | ' order by line_number), '') as s from ic_opposite_unit where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IA'

steps.title: DB A หลังแก้ไข: ตารางบาร์โค้ดและราคา
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg((case when barcode ~ '^2[0-9]{12}$' then 'EAN' when barcode ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' then 'D4' else barcode end) || ':' || unit_code || ':' || price::float8::text || ',' || price_member::float8::text || ',' || price_2::float8::text || ',' || price_member_2::float8::text || ',' || price_3::float8::text || ',' || price_member_3::float8::text || ',' || price_4::float8::text || ',' || price_member_4::float8::text || ':' || coalesce(hidden_text,0)::text || coalesce(no_point,0)::text || coalesce(is_clearance,0)::text || ':' || coalesce(from_date::text,'') || '~' || coalesce(to_date::text,''), ' | ' order by line_number), '') as s from ic_inventory_barcode where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IA'

steps.title: DB A หลังแก้ไข: ตารางคลัง/ที่เก็บ
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg(wh_code || '/' || shelf_code || ':' || coalesce(shelf_list,'') || ':' || coalesce(min_point,0)::text || ':' || coalesce(max_point,0)::float8::text || ':' || coalesce(status,0)::text, ' | ' order by wh_code, shelf_code), '') as s from ic_wh_shelf where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IA'

steps.title: DB A หลังแก้ไข: ต้นทุนมาตรฐาน
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg(date_start::text || ':' || unit_code || ':' || cost1::float8::text, ' | ' order by date_start), '') as s from ic_standard_cost where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IA'

steps.title: DB A หลังแก้ไข: ค่าที่ระบบคำนวณเองหลังบันทึก
steps.sql: select coalesce(i.unit_standard_name,'') as ustd_name, coalesce(i.unit_standard_stand_value,0)::float8::text as ustd_st, coalesce(i.unit_standard_divide_value,0)::float8::text as ustd_dv, (select count(*) from ic_inventory_barcode b where b.ic_code = i.code and coalesce(b.description,'') <> i.name_1)::text as bad_desc, case when coalesce(i.create_code,'') <> '' and i.create_datetime is not null then 'ok' else 'bad' end as created_by from ic_inventory i where i.code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IA'

steps.title: DB: master_logs บันทึกการเพิ่ม 1 แก้ไข 1
steps.sql: select count(*) filter (where function_code = 1)::text as n_new, count(*) filter (where function_code = 2)::text as n_edit, count(*) filter (where function_code = 3)::text as n_del from master_logs where menu_name = 'menu_ic_item_detail' and code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IA'

steps.title: DB: ลำดับที่ของหน่วยนับที่แก้เป็น 7 ถูกบันทึก (แถว 3 ต้องเป็น 7)

steps.sql: select i.code as code, i.name_1 as name_1, coalesce(i.name_2::text,'') as name_2, coalesce(i.name_eng_1::text,'') as name_eng_1, coalesce(i.name_eng_2::text,'') as name_eng_2, coalesce(i.unit_cost::text,'') as unit_cost, coalesce(i.unit_standard::text,'') as unit_standard, coalesce(i.income_type::text,'') as income_type, coalesce(i.item_pattern::text,'') as item_pattern, coalesce(i.supplier_code::text,'') as supplier_code, coalesce(i.sign_code::text,'') as sign_code, coalesce(i.manufacturer_code::text,'') as manufacturer_code, coalesce(i.account_code_1::text,'') as account_code_1, coalesce(i.account_code_2::text,'') as account_code_2, coalesce(i.account_code_3::text,'') as account_code_3, coalesce(i.account_code_4::text,'') as account_code_4, coalesce(i.tax_type,0)::text as tax, coalesce(i.item_type,0)::text as itype, coalesce(i.unit_type,0)::text as utype, coalesce(i.cost_type,0)::text as ctype, coalesce(i.ic_serial_no,0)::text as serial, coalesce(i.update_detail,0)::text as upd_detail, coalesce(i.update_price,0)::text as upd_price, coalesce(i.drink_type,0)::text as drink, coalesce(i.use_expire,0)::text as expire, coalesce(i.barcode_checker_print,0)::text as bcprint, coalesce(i.print_order_per_unit,0)::text as pounit, coalesce(i.is_eordershow,0)::text as eorder, coalesce(i.is_speech,0)::text as speech, coalesce(i.pos_no_sum,0)::text as posno, coalesce(i.production_period,0)::text as prod, coalesce(d.have_point,0)::text as point from ic_inventory i left join ic_inventory_detail d on upper(d.ic_code) = upper(i.code) where i.code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IB'

steps.title: DB: มีสินค้าของรอบนี้ 3 รายการ
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as cnt from ic_inventory where code ~ ('^UAT' || :'run_short' || 'I[ABC]$')

steps.title: DB C (หน่วยนับเดี่ยว): หัวสินค้าและธงทุกตัว
steps.sql: select i.code as code, i.name_1 as name_1, coalesce(i.name_2::text,'') as name_2, coalesce(i.name_eng_1::text,'') as name_eng_1, coalesce(i.name_eng_2::text,'') as name_eng_2, coalesce(i.unit_cost::text,'') as unit_cost, coalesce(i.unit_standard::text,'') as unit_standard, coalesce(i.income_type::text,'') as income_type, coalesce(i.item_pattern::text,'') as item_pattern, coalesce(i.supplier_code::text,'') as supplier_code, coalesce(i.sign_code::text,'') as sign_code, coalesce(i.manufacturer_code::text,'') as manufacturer_code, coalesce(i.account_code_1::text,'') as account_code_1, coalesce(i.account_code_2::text,'') as account_code_2, coalesce(i.account_code_3::text,'') as account_code_3, coalesce(i.account_code_4::text,'') as account_code_4, coalesce(i.tax_type,0)::text as tax, coalesce(i.item_type,0)::text as itype, coalesce(i.unit_type,0)::text as utype, coalesce(i.cost_type,0)::text as ctype, coalesce(i.ic_serial_no,0)::text as serial, coalesce(i.update_detail,0)::text as upd_detail, coalesce(i.update_price,0)::text as upd_price, coalesce(i.drink_type,0)::text as drink, coalesce(i.use_expire,0)::text as expire, coalesce(i.barcode_checker_print,0)::text as bcprint, coalesce(i.print_order_per_unit,0)::text as pounit, coalesce(i.is_eordershow,0)::text as eorder, coalesce(i.is_speech,0)::text as speech, coalesce(i.pos_no_sum,0)::text as posno, coalesce(i.production_period,0)::text as prod, coalesce(d.have_point,0)::text as point from ic_inventory i left join ic_inventory_detail d on upper(d.ic_code) = upper(i.code) where i.code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IC'

expect.value: สินค้าเดี่ยว GAMMA{{run.short}}

steps.title: DB C (หน่วยนับเดี่ยว): ตารางหน่วยนับ
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg(code || ':' || stand_value::float8::text || '/' || divide_value::float8::text || ':' || coalesce(width_length_height,'') || ':' || case when weight ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' then weight::float8::text else coalesce(weight,'') end || ':' || coalesce(unit_size::float8::text,'') || ':' || coalesce(status,0)::text, ' | ' order by line_number), '') as s from ic_unit_use where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IC'

steps.title: DB C (หน่วยนับเดี่ยว): ตารางหน่วยนับเทียบ
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg(unit_code || ':' || stand_value::float8::text || '/' || divide_value::float8::text || ':' || round(ratio,4)::float8::text || ':' || coalesce(status,0)::text, ' | ' order by line_number), '') as s from ic_opposite_unit where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IC'

steps.title: DB C (หน่วยนับเดี่ยว): ตารางบาร์โค้ดและราคา
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg((case when barcode ~ '^2[0-9]{12}$' then 'EAN' when barcode ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' then 'D4' else barcode end) || ':' || unit_code || ':' || price::float8::text || ',' || price_member::float8::text || ',' || price_2::float8::text || ',' || price_member_2::float8::text || ',' || price_3::float8::text || ',' || price_member_3::float8::text || ',' || price_4::float8::text || ',' || price_member_4::float8::text || ':' || coalesce(hidden_text,0)::text || coalesce(no_point,0)::text || coalesce(is_clearance,0)::text || ':' || coalesce(from_date::text,'') || '~' || coalesce(to_date::text,''), ' | ' order by line_number), '') as s from ic_inventory_barcode where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IC'

steps.title: DB C (หน่วยนับเดี่ยว): ตารางคลัง/ที่เก็บ
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg(wh_code || '/' || shelf_code || ':' || coalesce(shelf_list,'') || ':' || coalesce(min_point,0)::text || ':' || coalesce(max_point,0)::float8::text || ':' || coalesce(status,0)::text, ' | ' order by wh_code, shelf_code), '') as s from ic_wh_shelf where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IC'

steps.title: DB C (หน่วยนับเดี่ยว): ต้นทุนมาตรฐาน
steps.sql: select count(*)::text as n, coalesce(string_agg(date_start::text || ':' || unit_code || ':' || cost1::float8::text, ' | ' order by date_start), '') as s from ic_standard_cost where ic_code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IC'

steps.title: DB C (หน่วยนับเดี่ยว): ค่าที่ระบบคำนวณเองหลังบันทึก
steps.sql: select coalesce(i.unit_standard_name,'') as ustd_name, coalesce(i.unit_standard_stand_value,0)::float8::text as ustd_st, coalesce(i.unit_standard_divide_value,0)::float8::text as ustd_dv, (select count(*) from ic_inventory_barcode b where b.ic_code = i.code and coalesce(b.description,'') <> i.name_1)::text as bad_desc, case when coalesce(i.create_code,'') <> '' and i.create_datetime is not null then 'ok' else 'bad' end as created_by from ic_inventory i where i.code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IC'

steps.title: DB: master_logs บันทึกการเพิ่ม C 1 ครั้ง
steps.sql: select count(*) filter (where function_code = 1)::text as n_new, count(*) filter (where function_code = 2)::text as n_edit, count(*) filter (where function_code = 3)::text as n_del from master_logs where menu_name = 'menu_ic_item_detail' and code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IC'

steps.sql: select i.code as code, i.name_1 as name_1, coalesce(i.name_2::text,'') as name_2, coalesce(i.name_eng_1::text,'') as name_eng_1, coalesce(i.name_eng_2::text,'') as name_eng_2, coalesce(i.unit_cost::text,'') as unit_cost, coalesce(i.unit_standard::text,'') as unit_standard, coalesce(i.income_type::text,'') as income_type, coalesce(i.item_pattern::text,'') as item_pattern, coalesce(i.supplier_code::text,'') as supplier_code, coalesce(i.sign_code::text,'') as sign_code, coalesce(i.manufacturer_code::text,'') as manufacturer_code, coalesce(i.account_code_1::text,'') as account_code_1, coalesce(i.account_code_2::text,'') as account_code_2, coalesce(i.account_code_3::text,'') as account_code_3, coalesce(i.account_code_4::text,'') as account_code_4, coalesce(i.tax_type,0)::text as tax, coalesce(i.item_type,0)::text as itype, coalesce(i.unit_type,0)::text as utype, coalesce(i.cost_type,0)::text as ctype, coalesce(i.ic_serial_no,0)::text as serial, coalesce(i.update_detail,0)::text as upd_detail, coalesce(i.update_price,0)::text as upd_price, coalesce(i.drink_type,0)::text as drink, coalesce(i.use_expire,0)::text as expire, coalesce(i.barcode_checker_print,0)::text as bcprint, coalesce(i.print_order_per_unit,0)::text as pounit, coalesce(i.is_eordershow,0)::text as eorder, coalesce(i.is_speech,0)::text as speech, coalesce(i.pos_no_sum,0)::text as posno, coalesce(i.production_period,0)::text as prod, coalesce(d.have_point,0)::text as point from ic_inventory i left join ic_inventory_detail d on upper(d.ic_code) = upper(i.code) where i.code = 'UAT' || :'run_short' || 'IC'

cleanup.title: ลบเอกสารทดสอบที่ใช้สินค้า UAT ที่ค้าง (เลขที่รูปแบบ UAT+6 ตัว+IG เท่านั้น)

cleanup.sql: delete from ic_unit_use where upper(ic_code) ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from ic_opposite_unit where upper(ic_code) ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from ic_wh_shelf where upper(ic_code) ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from ic_inventory_detail where upper(ic_code) ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from ic_name_billing where upper(ic_code) ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from ic_name_merket where upper(ic_code) ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from ic_color_use where upper(ic_code) ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from ic_size_use where upper(ic_code) ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from ic_name_short where upper(ic_code) ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from ic_name_pos where upper(ic_code) ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from ic_pattern_use where upper(ic_code) ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from ic_inventory_barcode where upper(ic_code) ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from ic_standard_cost where upper(ic_code) ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from ic_inventory_price where upper(ic_code) ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from ic_inventory_discount where upper(ic_code) ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from ic_inventory_price_formula where upper(ic_code) ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from ic_inventory_purchase_price where upper(ic_code) ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from ic_inventory_set_detail where upper(ic_set_code) ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from images where image_id ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'

cleanup.title: ลบสินค้า UAT ที่ค้างจากรอบนี้หรือรอบที่ถูกขัดจังหวะ และประวัติ master_logs ของรหัสเหล่านั้น
cleanup.sql: delete from ic_inventory where code ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'; delete from master_logs where menu_name = 'menu_ic_item_detail' and code ~ '^UAT[0-9A-Z]{6}I[ABC]$'
